question: Can the sourced minimal Pati-Salam/Jordan scalar content physically realize the one common coefficient line required by claim 1521?

selectedDirac.sourceCoefficient: selected entry of k^nu (or its light-Higgs projected combination)

selectedNullMajorana.primitive: S_-3 nu_P^c nu_N^c after family breaking
selectedNullMajorana.sourcedNonlinearOrigin: H_M=Delta Delta with Delta=(2_R,1_L,4), generation blind in the published model
selectedNullMajorana.lowEnergyScalarCarrier: electroweak singlet S_-3 in the proposed family extension
selectedNullMajorana.sourceCoefficient: selected-null entry of k^nu_R or lambda_M

gaugeRepresentationNoGo.reason: Every Dirac scalar carrier is an SU(2)_L doublet, while every Majorana scalar carrier and Delta is an SU(2)_L singlet.
gaugeRepresentationNoGo.lowEnergyReason: The selected Dirac mass uses an electroweak doublet; the selected-null Majorana mass uses an electroweak singlet.

familyChargeNoGo.conclusion: One nonzero scalar in an unbroken U(1)_X representation cannot simultaneously have charge 0 and -3.
familyChargeNoGo.jordanBoundary: The population-normal Jordan faces Delta_0 and Delta_-3 are two Majorana-sector copies; neither is the Dirac bidoublet, and calling them one Jordan carrier does not make them one scalar field.

jAndCpAudit.jAction: J sends the Dirac arrow to its conjugate Dirac arrow and the Majorana defect to its conjugate defect; it does not exchange their supports.
jAndCpAudit.conclusion: Reality supplies Hermitian-conjugate terms and CP can make both coefficients real, but neither condition imposes k_M=kappa k_D.

operatorDimensionAudit.chargedScalarInSelectedDirac: S_-3 L_P H nu_P^c has dimension 5 and nonzero family charge, so it is not the selected Dirac invariant.
operatorDimensionAudit.chargedScalarInCrossDirac: S_-3 L_P H nu_N^c/Lambda is dimension 5 and is the dangerous cross-Dirac operator, not the safe selected Dirac portal.
operatorDimensionAudit.neutralModulus: A new neutral dimension-one scalar chi can multiply both already-invariant operators only at dimension 5, but the two Wilson coefficients remain independent.

candidateScalarAudit.reason: Majorana dressing factor, not a bidoublet and generation blind
Majorana scalar irreps have SU(2)_L dimension one
conditional two-copy Majorana alphabet, not one field and not the Dirac Higgs
family-charged singlet; insertion into a Dirac operator gives the dimension-five cross channel
can occur in both higher-dimensional monomials but does not relate their two Wilson coefficients

oneFieldVersusOneCoupling.oneFieldStatement: The occurrence of one scalar chi in two independent invariant monomials produces lambda_D chi O_D + lambda_M chi O_M, with coefficient space C^2.
oneFieldVersusOneCoupling.oneCouplingStatement: A common coefficient line is the stronger assertion (k_D,k_M)=lambda(c_D,c_M) with fixed embeddings c_D,c_M.
oneFieldVersusOneCoupling.vevBoundary: Even a shared numerical lambda does not by itself fix the mass ray unless the normalized embeddings, including v_H and v_S or their matching factors, are fixed: d=lambda c_D v_H and y=lambda c_M v_S.
oneFieldVersusOneCoupling.counterexample: Two packets can share lambda but use embedding vectors (1,1) and (1,2), whose minor is nonzero.

minimalNewSpurionTheorem.ordinaryScalarResult: No scalar in the sourced minimal Pati-Salam/Jordan inventory feeds both portal lines, and adding one neutral scalar field still leaves two independent invariant couplings.
minimalNewSpurionTheorem.minimalDatum: One dimension-zero, gauge-neutral, family-neutral portal-label spurion/coupling object Lambda with fixed nonzero embeddings into the Dirac and Majorana invariant operator lines.
minimalNewSpurionTheorem.jCompatibility: The conjugate action uses conjugate(Lambda), conjugate(c_D), conjugate(c_M).
minimalNewSpurionTheorem.cpCompatibility: Exact CP permits a real basis for Lambda and the embeddings, but does not determine their ratio.
minimalNewSpurionTheorem.whatWouldEnforceIt: A new operator-label exchange/duality, correspondence-module universal map, or ultraviolet Ward identity with exactly one invariant contraction.
notEnough: the H_2(R) Jordan organization of the Majorana copies

physicalStatus.minimalNewFieldCountAlone: no finite answer: a field without a new relation still permits two couplings
physicalStatus.nextTest: Construct a physical correspondence or Ward identity giving one invariant contraction into both portal lines, then test its normalized VEV embeddings and one-loop tangency.

verdict: The minimal sourced Pati-Salam/Jordan scalar content cannot realize the claim-1521 common coefficient line. The smallest viable addition is not one ordinary scalar but one new dimension-zero portal-label coupling object or an equivalent symmetry/Ward identity enforcing a single invariant contraction.
